title: Hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <clipPath id='topBulb'>
      <path d='M28 12 L72 12 L50 46 Z'/>
    </clipPath>
    <clipPath id='botBulb'>
      <path d='M28 88 L72 88 L50 54 Z'/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>
  <!-- wooden top plate -->
  <rect x='22' y='6' width='56' height='7' rx='3' fill='#c8823c'/>
  <rect x='22' y='6' width='56' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e8a860'/>
  <!-- wooden bottom plate -->
  <rect x='22' y='87' width='56' height='7' rx='3' fill='#c8823c'/>
  <rect x='22' y='87' width='56' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e8a860'/>
  <!-- glass body -->
  <path d='M28 13 L72 13 L50 50 L72 87 L28 87 L50 50 Z' fill='#4a5a78'/>
  <!-- sand in top bulb -->
  <g clip-path='url(#topBulb)'>
    <path d='M28 13 L72 13 L50 46 Z' fill='#f6d24a' transform='translate(0,14)'/>
    <path d='M28 13 L72 13 L50 46 Z' fill='#ffe98a' transform='translate(0,14) scale(1,0.55)'/>
    <!-- sand stream -->
    <rect x='47' y='40' width='6' height='18' fill='#f6d24a'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sand pile in bottom bulb -->
  <g clip-path='url(#botBulb)'>
    <path d='M30 87 L70 87 L50 68 Z' fill='#f6d24a'/>
    <path d='M36 87 L64 87 L50 76 Z' fill='#ffe98a'/>
    <rect x='47' y='56' width='6' height='12' fill='#f6d24a'/>
  </g>
  <!-- glass highlights -->
  <path d='M33 16 L46 45 L42 45 L30 18 Z' fill='#8fa8cc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M33 84 L46 55 L42 55 L30 82 Z' fill='#8fa8cc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- neck waists -->
  <path d='M44 48 L56 48 L56 52 L44 52 Z' fill='#3a4862'/>
</svg>
